description.text: The burning battlefield stretches below a huge black dragon with scarred scales and smoke-dulled wings, its heavy wingbeats driving it low over ruined siege towers and scattered fires.
A knight in battered, dented plate armour is braced in a worn saddle at the base of the dragon's neck, shield strapped tight, as embers and ash whip past.
The pair sweeps over the shattered ground in a fast, heavy pass, the dragon's shadow rolling across the flames.
The dragon beats its scarred wings in a low, heavy pass over the burning battlefield, ruined siege towers and scattered fires streaming beneath it.
Deep wingbeats pound over a roar of fires, rushing wind, and distant battle clamor.
Embers and ash whip past the knight as firelight glints across his dented plate armour and strapped shield.
The knight turns his helmeted head toward the lines below and shouts a short command over the din, one gauntleted hand tightening on the saddle horn.
The knight keeps his helmeted head turned toward the lines below, jaw set after his command, as the dragon rocks beneath him.
Firelight flashes across the dented metal of his shield, and wind and smoke stream past his visor.
His gauntleted hand holds the saddle horn while the beast's wingbeat jolts his posture.
The knight holds his helmeted head toward the battlefield below, jaw set after the command, as the dragon rocks beneath him.
Wingbeats and crackling flames press close, with wind hissing past the rider.
Firelight flashes across the dented plate and strapped shield while smoke streams past the visor.
The dragon banks and drives upward through a curtain of black smoke, scarred wings beating hard as embers swirl off them.
The knight leans into the steep climb, shield tight against his arm, while the burning field and ruined towers fall away beneath them.
Smoke swallows the edges of the battlefield as the dragon carries its rider higher.
The dragon banks and drives upward through black smoke, its scarred wings beating hard.
A rising surge of wingbeats carries over fire and wind as the ground noise recedes.
Embers swirl off the dragon's wings and the burning field falls away beneath the climbing pair.
The knight leans into the steep climb, his shield tight against his arm, as smoke swallows the battlefield below.

summary.text: Under a sky stained by fire and smoke, a huge black dragon with scarred scales and smoke-dulled wings beats low over a burning battlefield.
Ruined siege towers and scattered fires stream beneath it, and embers and ash whip through the air.
A knight in battered, dented plate armour rides braced in a worn saddle at the base of the dragon's neck, a shield strapped tight to his arm.
The beast carries him in a heavy, fast pass above the shattered ground, the heat and wind pressing against them.
The knight turns his helmeted head toward the lines below and shouts a short command over the din, his gauntleted hand tightening on the saddle horn.
The dragon's wingbeat jolts his posture, and firelight flashes across the dented metal.
After the command, the knight keeps his head turned, jaw set, scanning the battlefield as the dragon rocks beneath him.
Then the dragon banks and drives upward through a curtain of black smoke.
Embers swirl off its wings, the burning field falls away, and the knight leans into the steep climb while wind and fire recede below.
The sequence moves from a low, perilous pass over the flames to a steep ascent into smoke, keeping the rider and dragon at the center of the action.

claims.text: A cinematic sequence shows a knight in battered plate armour riding a huge black dragon low over a burning battlefield.
The battlefield includes ruined siege towers, scattered fires, black smoke, wind-driven embers, and ash.
The dragon has scarred scales and smoke-dulled wings; the knight's plate armour is dented and his shield is strapped tight.
